name: Shopify Sync
description: Sync cadence, direction and CCT storage for the Shopify Sync toolkit. Two WordPress controls are deliberately absent: the connection checklist reads the Remote Sites store, and Catalog API search terms are persisted as an array rather than a string, so neither round-trips through the manifest settings store.

settings.label: Sync interval (minutes)
settings.description: How often the full sync runs. Webhooks cover the gaps at zero API cost.

settings.label: Sync mode
settings.description: Full pulls images, prices, tags, vendor and every inventory level; minimal pulls title, SKU and stock only.

settings.label: Sync direction
settings.description: Read-only caches the catalog without writing to WooCommerce.

settings.label: Enable webhooks
settings.description: Real-time inventory updates pushed by Shopify, at zero API cost.

settings.label: Update WooCommerce stock
settings.description: Writes Shopify stock quantities back to WooCommerce products.

settings.label: Low stock threshold
settings.description: Quantity below which an item is reported as low stock.

settings.label: CCT slug
settings.description: JetEngine CCT slug used for inventory storage, which must be unique. Leave blank to use the toolkit default.
